items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Well, Judge always did play with me, you know, the job and he wasn't doing nothing. Well, that was my side drummer, you know?

ctx.x: When I went on the Dixie, we used to have a contest. Every 17 days, this band used to have a little band around here, they called it Alley Cat. And why was it Duke Deja on this Dixieland serenade? Well, we didn't have no drum on the boat, see? Well, Judge always did play with me, you know, the job and he wasn't doing nothing. Well, that was my side drummer, you know? So, when we hit time, somebody said, well, you know something. You know Judge been playing with Harold around here. The Judge is not on that boat…

He likes it, too. Yeah. They bass, too, you know. Yeah. Just a couple of more minutes on here. You wanted to hear Pedro play a piece. If it feels like it... It's not a Sunday style. How you feel like it? Yeah, I guess I can.
